items.exampleEn: The software is free, but you need to buy new hardware to run it.
items.exampleZh: 這套軟體是免費的，但你得買新硬體才能執行。

items.exampleEn: The teacher uses interactive videos to keep students interested.
items.exampleZh: 老師用互動式影片讓學生保持興趣。

items.exampleEn: Our office microwave is always busy at lunchtime.
items.exampleZh: 我們辦公室的微波爐在午餐時間總是有人在用。

items.exampleEn: Good programmers often spend hours finding a single mistake.
items.exampleZh: 好的程式設計師常常花好幾個小時找出一個錯誤。

items.exampleEn: She made a spreadsheet to plan the wedding guests and tables.
items.exampleZh: 她做了一份試算表來安排婚禮的賓客和桌次。

items.exampleEn: The electrician fixed the wires behind the wall.
items.exampleZh: 電工修好了牆壁後面的電線。

items.exampleEn: The website asks every user to choose a password.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站要求每位使用者設定一組密碼。

items.exampleEn: The old telescope in the museum belonged to a famous scientist.
items.exampleZh: 博物館裡那架舊望遠鏡曾屬於一位知名科學家。

items.sentenceEn: The museum has an interactive room where children can touch everything.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館有一間互動展間，孩子們可以摸所有的東西。

items.audioEn: Please don't put metal plates in the microwave; use the glass ones instead.
items.audioZh: 請不要把金屬盤子放進微波爐，改用玻璃的。
items.questionZh: 說話者要大家用什麼放進微波爐？

items.sentenceEn: My brother works as a programmer for a game company.
items.sentenceZh: 我哥哥在一家遊戲公司當程式設計師。

items.sentenceEn: My cousin is learning to be an electrician at a night school.
items.sentenceZh: 我表哥在夜校學當電工。

items.stemEn: I put all the students' test scores in a ____ so I can compare them.
items.stemZh: 我把所有學生的考試成績放進試算表，方便比較。

items.stemEn: The new phone is easy to use, even for a first-time ____.
items.stemZh: 這支新手機很容易用，連第一次使用的人都會用。

items.passageEn: Our school's science club meets every Friday. Last month, a programmer from a local company came to teach us how to make a simple interactive game. Then we built a small robot with cheap hardware and components from an electronics shop. One student connected the wrong cable, and all the lights in the room went out, so the school electrician had to help us. Our teacher keeps track of the club's money in a spreadsheet, and she was happy that every part cost less than expected. At night, we sometimes look at the moon through a telescope on the roof. Over fifty users have already played our game online.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的科學社每週五聚會。上個月，一位當地公司的程式設計師來教我們做一個簡單的互動遊戲。接著，我們用電子材料行買來的便宜硬體和零件做了一個小機器人。有一位同學接錯了線，教室裡的燈全熄了，學校的電工只好來幫忙。老師用試算表記錄社團的花費，她很高興每個零件都比預期便宜。晚上，我們有時會在屋頂上用望遠鏡看月亮。已經有五十多位使用者在網路上玩過我們的遊戲了。

questions.questionZh: 程式設計師教了社員什麼？
options: 怎麼做一個簡單的互動遊戲

questions.questionZh: 為什麼需要學校電工幫忙？

items.promptZh: 我用微波爐把昨天的菜加熱了。
referenceEn: I heated yesterday's food in the microwave.
I warmed up yesterday's dinner in the microwave.
rubricZh: 「微波爐」可寫，例如 microwave、microwave oven 等
「加熱」可寫，例如 heat up、warm up 等
時態合理（例如 heated、warmed up 等）

items.promptZh: 我弟弟生日時收到一台望遠鏡當禮物。
referenceEn: My younger brother got a telescope as a birthday present.
My little brother received a telescope for his birthday.
rubricZh: 「望遠鏡」可寫，例如 telescope 等
「收到…當禮物」可寫，例如 got … as a birthday present、received … for his birthday 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 got、has got 等）
